question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Earned
solution:
The correct answer is **'Gained'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Earned"** generally refers to receiving something in return for work or services done. ("कमाया" or "अर्जित").

 
 
• **Example: **She has earned a reputation for being reliable and hardworking.
 
 
 
• **"Gained" **means to obtain or secure something especially as a result of effort. ("प्राप्त किया" or "हासिल किया").
 
 
• **Example:** Through continuous efforts, he gained the support of the community.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is**- 'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Offered'** generally implies making something available or providing something willingly. ("प्रस्तावित" or "पेश की").
 
• **'Gave'** signifies a voluntary act of providing or transferring something to someone. It doesn't infer a return or reward for services done or work performed, like "earned". ("दिया" or "प्रदान की").
 
• **'Accorded' **usually means to give someone special treatment or a particular status. ("प्रदान की गई" or "स्वीकृत").
